sheets.prompt: Character design lineup for a science fiction exploration game: seven keepers of a station inside a sun, standing in a row at the same scale on a plain cream background, full body, each clearly different: an old head listener in long white and gold wrapped robes with a tall brass ear-trumpet and a smoked glass visor pushed up on her brow; a young louvre turner with a long hand crank over his shoulder, sleeves tied back, arms tanned dark; a flare docker in a heavy white heat-proof suit and round smoked glass helmet, carrying a glowing jar of liquid light on a chain; a shade gardener in layered pale teal and white wraps with a wide parasol hat and a basket of shadow ferns; a child with a little shade-fan on a pole held over her head; a tall masked keeper of the temple in an indigo veil with the glyph of three dots over an upward arc embroidered in gold; a lamp-maker with an apron of tools and a rack of empty glass lamps on his back. The small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack stands at the end of the row for scale. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, white-gold, saffron and apricot, cool teal, warm brass, deep indigo and violet shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
